title: Launcher: a Setup item that makes a one-offer page from the Space's own first offering

source.ref: Owner direction 2026-10-29: create a sales funnel / splash page; design approved 2026-10-30 (/mnt/project-files/launcher-lightbox/splash/)

detail: Setup (Money group) gains 'Publish a page for one offer'. It opens /spaces/<slug>/manage/offer, which makes an 'offer' profile page seeded from the Space's first offering (About, one Offering with its price, Booking, a closing Callout with no link until the owner adds one) and opens it in the existing page editor. Done when the offer page has a stored document. Extra pages are the paid multi-page upsell, so a Space without it is pointed to plans; a Space with no offering is pointed to list one first. Idempotent: an existing page is opened, never overwritten.

verify.evidence: The starter, the route, the Setup item and the start action exist.
